Flow.description: New button on Lead. One screen laid out like the Lead page layout (Personal Details, Lead Details, Company Information). On Save the phone and email are checked: an existing customer gets an enquiry Case instead of a Lead; an open Lead with the same phone or email is shown as a banner on the form; otherwise the Lead is created. A blank Company makes the Lead B2C and the system assigns "<Name> B2C (<Lead Number>)".

ℹ {!Full_Name} is already a customer

This phone or email belongs to {!Check_Customer.accountName}. Instead of a duplicate Lead, raise an enquiry on their account - it goes straight to their account owner. The details you entered are already filled in below; add anything further if needed.
